svg.title: How a card waited for a layer that nobody finishes
svg.desc: The social plugin of Material draws the layers of its preview cards in threads. The first card that needs a layer puts an empty placeholder under its key, and then replaces it with the job. A second card that asks in between waits for the placeholder. Nothing ever finished that, so the build hung until the five minutes of its step ended. Now the job also finishes the placeholder that it replaces, and both cards get the picture of the layer.
